high_level_description: This image captures a vibrant scene from Times Square at night, a bustling urban area known for its bright billboards, advertisements, and lively atmosphere. The photo is taken from a low angle, looking up towards the towering buildings and illuminated signs. Buildings and Billboards: The image prominently features several large digital billboards displaying various advertisements. Visible brands include "Samsung," "Barclays," "Wicked" (a Broadway show), "Little Shop of Horrors," and "The Times Square Edition." The "Liquid Cooled AI Data Centers" sign stands out on the left
